name: Tinfoil Coffin
source:
The ship was hit... and now you're suspended in the vast abyss of space... waiting to die.

The ship's onboard AI Laika refuses to wake up the rest of the crew, for fear of putting the delivery in more danger. With no other options you talk to them, using your last moments to reflect on the life that led you here; your family, your friends, your regrets, and whether your life was worth anything at all.

Tinfoil Coffin is a melancholic look at life, regret, and love through the lens of accepting your own mortality.

[From [url=https://phantombadger.itch.io/tinfoil-coffin]itch.io[/url]]
